landing.headline: Every centimeter counts
landing.aboutDescription: Traditional pattern layouts often lead to unnecessary fabric waste, and hours of manual shifting. CutSense takes the guesswork out of preparation by using intelligent nesting algorithms built specifically for digital sewing patterns. Simply upload your pattern pieces, set the roll width, grainline rules, and required margins, and the system instantly computes the densest possible layout across every meter of fabric. By automating the planning phase, you reduce preparation time from hours to seconds while keeping raw material expenses under strict control.
